description: Copy a database's schema — fields (including select/multi-select/workflow options with their colours), views and self-relations — into a new, fully independent database in the same space. Formulas and filtered views keep working in the copy (api_names are preserved; only internal ids are fresh). [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES duplicate_database"]

include_records.description: Copy up to 50 records along with the schema. Default false (schema only).

name.description: Name for the copy. Defaults to "<source> copy", disambiguated if that name is taken.

name: duplicate_database
title: Duplicate database
